name: Bokura no Roshutsu Game
source:
Recently we're playing a lot. The game is a combination of dares and rock-paper-scissors.
I like it when everyone is looking at my naked body, but I'm also ashamed. Today... I lost the game. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142569.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
最近我们玩得很多。该游戏是胆敢和石头剪刀布的结合。
我喜欢每个人都看着我赤裸的身体，但我也感到羞耻。今天……我输了比赛。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142569.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
